channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Warren Buffett stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
item.description: Buffett's son, Howard, will replace him as chairman as dictated by a long-standing succession plan, Berkshire said.

item.title: AI safety debate meets reality at Dreamforce as business leaders say last year's models are enough
item.description: At Salesforce's annual mega-conference in San Francisco, attendees said they get enough value from older AI models.

item.title: Putin targets Nestle's Russian business as Kremlin tightens grip on Western assets
item.description: Nestlé is assessing its options after Russia placed the Swiss food giant’s local assets under temporary external administration.

item.title: Trump administration advances $24.3 billion fighter jet deal to Saudi Arabia as Houthis escalate attacks
item.description: The deal comes as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia and seek control of the strategically important Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: Apple to fly higher as new, more expensive iPhones hit market, Evercore ISI says
item.description: Apple is likely to get a boost from its newest wave of smartphones, including the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, per Evercore ISI.

item.title: Beauty, health and wellness are converging into one retail category
item.description: As consumers prioritize holistic retail purchases, beauty, health and wellness are increasingly converging into one category and one consumer budget.

item.title: Oil prices fall for third day on Saudi Arabia supply hopes; U.S. crude briefly dips below $100
item.description: Oil prices fell on Friday as additional Saudi crude supplies help ease disruption fears.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI hunt for smaller data center deals, sources tell CNBC, in race to deploy AI capacity
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have announced a flurry of AI infrastructure deals over the past year as demand booms.

item.title: JPMorgan oil team gives up on forecasting Iran war endgame as Trump blows past economic redlines
item.description: JPMorgan assumed at the start of the war that several economic redlines would force President Donald Trump into an agreement to open the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: AI trade rebound sparks flurry of unusually bullish options activity
item.description: Options traders stormed into tech trades on Thursday.

item.title: As Republicans tout Trump's 'big beautiful bill,' here's who the tax breaks benefited most
item.description: As the midterm elections approach, Republicans are touting President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill" to voters. Here's who benefited from the tax cuts.

item.title: UN mission finds evidence signaling U.S. war crimes in Iran; Washington rejects report
item.description: The UN mission pointed out the missile strike on a primary school that killed over 150 people, as well as another airstrike which killed 22 civilians.

item.title: An intense boardroom battle is brewing at India's giant Tata Group
item.description: In 10 years, India's leading multinational conglomerate, the Tata Group, is facing a new power struggle between the chairman of Tata Sons and Tata Trusts.

item.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates to 31-year high, flags concerns over inflation
item.description: The decision was split 7-2, with board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato dissenting from the hike.

item.title: Bill to curb AI data center utility costs hits snag in Senate
item.description: Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M., blocked bipartisan legislation aimed at reining in data center-related utility cost increases, calling the bill a half-measure.

item.title: A Chinese AI company just connected its model to Wall Street's leading data providers
item.description: The startup Moonshot said it signed on financial industry giants from investment bank CICC to venture capital firms

item.title: Jim Cramer says history offers a playbook for navigating a Fed rate-hiking cycle
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said investors shouldn’t assume stocks will struggle for the entire period.

item.title: Tyson Foods is set to come back on several tailwinds, JPMorgan says
item.description: The investment bank upgraded the chicken and beef processor to overweight from neutral.

item.title: Lawmakers must 'keep their options open' on Social Security reform, former Treasury Secretary Jack Lew says
item.description: The next U.S. president and candidates for Senate this November will be tasked with addressing Social Security's funding shortfall.

item.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia will sell twice as many chips next year
item.description: Huang's comment is the latest forecast from Nvidia and points to continuing massive growth for the next six quarters.

item.title: What an Oscar-winning movie can teach us about investing through the AI slowdown debate
item.description: The problem for investors: much of what's flowing through the airwaves is noise and won't help you make money.

item.title: The Fed raised rates, but you can still get a good APR on a personal loan. These lenders can help
item.description: The Fed has increased its benchmark rate to curb inflation, but it means rising interest rates on loans.

item.title: Securitize jumps after regulators greenlight some tokenized U.S. stock trading
item.description: Securitize surged Thursday after federal regulators greenlit the issuing of tokenized stocks on some trading platforms in the U.S.

item.title: Anthropic shares 3 metrics to help AI companies monitor pace of development
item.description: Anthropic said it measured AI-led research and development, oversight of AI agents and compute allocation within the company.

item.title: AirAsia's Fernandes refutes financial concerns, points to new growth plans
item.description: AirAsia's Tony Fernandes pushed back against a report raising concerns over the airline’s financial health, while signaling plans to resume growth.

item.title: Parents are interfering with teens’ first jobs. Here’s why employers say it can backfire
item.description: Parents are sending their teens' work emails for them. “An employer may reasonably wonder whether the teenager can communicate independently," says expert.

item.title: Stephen Curry says his Li-Ning signature shoe will debut early next year
item.description: Golden State Warrior superstar Stephen Curry announced in June he was signing a long-term partnership with Chinese brand Li-Ning.

item.title: Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike
item.description: The yen weakened past 157 against the dollar, the yield on the 10-year Japanese Government Bond slipped, while the Nikkei 225 gained 1.5%.

item.title: Pokémon card curbs send shares of Japanese online marketplace Mercari on a bumpy ride
item.description: Mercari shares are clawing back losses after Pokémon card listing restrictions triggered a selloff earlier this week.

item.title: House heads home to campaign amid calls for urgent AI action
item.description: The urgency with which Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI have sought to be regulated has not translated into action on Capitol Hill.
